definitions.gloss: antique art; old art objects; classical art
definitions.explanation: Art objects and crafts from earlier periods, including paintings, ceramics, sculptures, lacquerware, and other traditional items valued for their age and craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {古美術|こびじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。

examples.english: There are many antique art shops on this street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{古美術|こびじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I went on a trip to Kyoto to appreciate Japanese antique art.

notes:
FORMS:
{古|こ} (old, ancient) + ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ (fine art). Refers specifically to art objects of historical value.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古美術|こびじゅつ}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (antique art shop)
- {古美術|こびじゅつ}⟦{商|しょう}→商：26727_shou⟧ (antique art dealer)
- {古美術|こびじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鑑定|かんてい}→鑑定：16030_kantei⟧ (appraisal of antique art)
- {古美術|こびじゅつ}{品|ひん} (antique art objects)
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{古美術|こびじゅつ} (Japanese antique art)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{骨董品|こっとうひん}→骨董品：06990_kottouhin⟧: antiques — broader category including non-art items
- ⟦{美術品|びじゅつひん}→美術品：28549_bijutsuhin⟧: art objects — not restricted to old items
